1.text: Gusenga k'umunyamubabaro iyo umutima we uguye isari, agasuka amaganya ye imbere y'Uwiteka.

2.text: Uwiteka, umva gusenga kwanjye,Gutaka kwanjye kukugereho.

3.text: Ntumpishe mu maso hawe ku munsi w'umubabaro wanjye,Untegere ugutwi ku munsi ntakiramo,Unsubize vuba.

4.text: Kuko iminsi yanjye ishirira mu mwotsi,Amagufwa yanjye yaka nk'urumuri.

5.text: Umutima wanjye umeze nk'ubwatsi bukubiswe urumye,Kuko nibagirwa kurya umutsima wanjye.

6.text: Ijwi ryo kuniha kwanjye,Ritumye amagufwa yanjye yumatana n'inyama yanjye.

7.text: Meze nk'uruyongoyongo rwo mu butayu,Mpindutse nk'igihunyira cyo mu misaka.

8.text: Mba maso,Mpindutse nk'igishwi kiri ku ipfundo ry'inzu cyonyine.

9.text: Abanzi banjye barantuka umunsi ukira,Abashajijwe no kundakarira bangize intukano.

10.text: Kuko ndya ivu nk'umutsima,Mvanga ibyo nywa n'amarira,

11.text: Ku bw'uburakari bwawe n'umujinya wawe,Kuko wanteruye ukanta.

12.text: Iminsi yanjye ihwanye n'igicucu kirehutse,Kandi numye nk'ubwatsi.

13.text: Ariko wowe Uwiteka, uzicara ku ntebe y'ubwami iteka,Urwibutso rwawe ruzahoraho ibihe byose.

14.text: Uzahaguruka ubabarire i Siyoni,Kuko igihe cyo kuhababarira gisohoye,Ni koko igihe cyategetswe kirasohoye.

15.text: Kuko abagaragu bawe bishimira amabuye yaho,Bababarira umukungugu waho.

16.text: Bizatuma amahanga yubaha izina ry'Uwiteka,N'abami bo mu isi bose bakubaha icyubahiro cyawe,

17.text: Kuko Uwiteka azaba asannye i Siyoni,Kandi abonekanye icyubahiro cy'ubwiza bwe,

18.text: Yitaye ku gusenga kw'abatagira shinge na rugero,Adasuzuguye gusenga kwabo.

19.text: Ibyo bizandikirwa ab'igihe kizaza,Ubwoko buzaremwa buzashima Uwiteka.

20.text: Kuko azaba arebye hasi, ari hejuru ahera he,Uwiteka arebeye isi mu ijuru,

21.text: Kugira ngo yumve kuniha kw'imbohe,Abohore abategekewe gupfa,

22.text: Ngo abantu bogereze izina ry'Uwiteka i Siyoni,N'ishimwe rye i Yerusalemu,

23.text: Ubwo amahanga n'ibihugu by'abami,Bizateranira gukorera Uwiteka.

24.text: Yacishirije bugufi imbaraga zanjye mu nzira,Yagabanije iminsi yanjye.

25.text: Ndavuga nti “Mana yanjye,Ntunkureho ngicagashije iminsi yanjye,Imyaka yawe ihoraho ibihe byose.

26.text: Mbere na mbere washyizeho urufatiro rw'isi,N'ijuru ni umurimo w'intoki zawe.

27.text: Ibyo bizashira ariko wowe ho uzahoraho,Ibyo byose bizasaza nk'umwenda,Uzabihindura nk'uko imyambaro ikuranwa,Bibe bihindutse ukundi.

28.text: Ariko wowe ho uri uko wahoze,Imyaka y'ubugingo bwawe ntizashira.

29.text: Abana b'abagaragu bawe bazahora mu gihugu,Urubyaro rwabo ruzakomerezwa imbere yawe.”
